description: This file defines the class AIMPaymentServices, which provides various methods for handling payment transactions via the Authorize.Net AIM API, including authorization, capture, refund, release (void), and related transaction processing functions within an OFBiz e-commerce platform.

classes.name: AIMPaymentServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for processing AIM-based transactions with Authorize.Net, including authorization, capture, refund, release (void), and combined auth/capture operations.

methods.name: isVoidableResponse
methods.description: Checks if a response code indicates a refund failure that can be handled by attempting to void the transaction.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs an authorization-only transaction with Authorize.Net AIM API and processes the response.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures funds against a prior authorization, using the transaction ID from the authorization.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Issues a refund through Authorize.Net and attempts to void the original authorization if refund fails and conditions allow.

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Releases (voids) an authorized transaction that has not yet settled.

methods.name: voidTransaction
methods.description: Helper method to void a specific authorization transaction.

methods.name: ccCredit
methods.description: Stub method indicating that credit is unsupported.

methods.name: ccAuthCapture
methods.description: Performs an authorization and capture in one step.

methods.name: processCard
methods.description: Sends the transaction request to Authorize.Net and parses the response; handles test mode and response code processing.

methods.name: buildAIMProperties
methods.description: Builds configuration properties for communicating with Authorize.Net based on provided context and configuration settings.

methods.name: buildMerchantInfo
methods.description: Adds merchant credentials and parameters to the AIM request.

methods.name: buildGatewayResponeConfig
methods.description: Configures response format preferences for AIM request.

methods.name: buildCustomerBillingInfo
methods.description: Extracts and adds billing information to the AIM request from various context objects.

methods.name: buildEmailSettings
methods.description: Adds email notification settings to the AIM request.

methods.name: buildInvoiceInfo
methods.description: Adds invoice number and description to the AIM request.

methods.name: buildAuthTransaction
methods.description: Prepares the AIM request for an authorization transaction, including card details and amount.

methods.name: buildCaptureTransaction
methods.description: Prepares the AIM request for a capture transaction based on a prior auth transaction.

methods.name: buildRefundTransaction
methods.description: Prepares the AIM request for refund transaction.

methods.name: buildVoidTransaction
methods.description: Prepares the AIM request to void a prior auth transaction.

methods.name: validateRequest
methods.description: Validates the AIM request before sending to the gateway.

methods.name: processAuthTransResult
methods.description: Processes the response of an authorization request and updates results accordingly.

methods.name: processCaptureTransResult
methods.description: Processes the response of a capture transaction.

methods.name: processRefundTransResult
methods.description: Processes the response of a refund transaction.

methods.name: processReleaseTransResult
methods.description: Processes the response of a void (release) transaction.

methods.name: processAuthCaptureTransResult
methods.description: Processes the combined authorization and capture transaction response.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for the payment gateway from either the database or properties.

methods.name: getCardType
methods.description: Converts internal card type strings to Authorize.Net expected codes.

methods.name: getXAmount
methods.description: Extracts the transaction amount from the AIM request map.
